QA Tester Summary

Verdict: Passed

The manual real-device validation completed all eight acceptance steps successfully. A typed comment was accepted by the Send action, appeared in the comments list, and remained available after the prescribed re-open/relaunch check. No coding defect was confirmed.

Test Execution

Area Result Evidence
Authentication Passed Authenticated tester session used for manual validation.
Comment composer Passed Input accepted text; Send control became enabled.
Send comment Passed One-tap submission succeeded.
Immediate UI result Passed New comment appeared at the top of the comment list.
Persistence Passed Comment remained after closing/re-opening comments and relaunching the app.

Test Methods

Method Coverage Result
Black-box User flow: open post, enter a comment, send, verify visible result and persistence. Passed
Gray-box Verified UI handler connects to addPostComment and /comments/add; runtime result assessed from the app. Passed
White-box review Reviewed trim/empty guard, API call, optimistic insertion, error handler, and cache-flush path. Passed
Confusion matrix Not applicable: this is a transactional UI/API flow, not a classification or prediction feature. N/A

Manual Real-Device Acceptance Matrix

# Step Expected Result Result
1 Log in with tester account Authenticated session available Passed
2 Open an owned/public post Post detail opens Passed
3 Tap Comment Comment sheet opens Passed
4 Enter a unique comment Text accepted Passed
5 Check Send state Send becomes enabled Passed
6 Tap Send once Comment submission succeeds Passed
7 Check comments list New comment appears at top Passed
8 Close/re-open comments or relaunch New comment persists Passed

Code Review

File Reviewed Behavior Result
src/pages/post-detail/_components/CommentsSheet.tsx Trims draft, blocks empty submission, calls onSubmit, then clears draft. Passed
src/pages/post-detail/hooks/use-post-detail-immersive-comments.ts Calls addPostComment, inserts optimistic comment, runs score/notification/cache side effects, exposes a recoverable error path. Passed
src/api/posts.ts Sends POST /comments/add with sid and comment through configured post client. Passed

Evidence — Real Device

Video: Clean real-device composer flow; no device notifications are visible.
